messages:
alice: Quick async triage for the upcoming branch cut (release/1.14). Can folks drop any backport requests, blockers, or changelog notes here in the next 24h? I want to create the release/* branch tomorrow AM and lock the cutoff the day before.
ben: ack. what's the official cutoff time? EOD PST tomorrow or earlier? :thinking:
alice: planning for 17:00 PT tomorrow. if you need exceptions, call them out now so we can decide.
carla: I have a cherry-pick for #4021 (fix for tokenization edge case) but it conflicts with the new tokenizer refactor.
carla: requesting a backport exception if we can resolve quickly — otherwise i'll hold to the next patch release.
james: can you paste the conflicting files? small PRs I can help rebase. also need a one-line changelog entry if we take it.
carla: conflict in transformer/tokenizer.py and tests/tokenizer_test.py. i'll attach the failing patch shortly.
maya: tagging @eng-releases label for visibility. also FYI, docs-only tweaks should go straight to main and we don't need backports unless they affect behavior.
ben: one quick note — we should enforce backports only for: security fixes, crash bugs, or major regressions. otherwise defer. saves churn.
alice: agreed. policy: "backports allowed for regressions/security/crash". docs/typing/perf not allowed unless blocking infra.
release-bot: reminder: branch-cut checklist: https://redwood.internal/wiki/release-branch-checklist :bell:
devops-bot: suggested branch creation command for tomorrow:

```
git checkout -b release/1.14 origin/main
hub api repos/redwood/repo/git/refs -X POST -F ref=refs/heads/release/1.14 -F sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
```

maya: also need owners for backport reviews — please add reviewer ping in the PR description like "backport-review: @<owner>".
james: if carla posts the patch here I'll pick up the rebase and try to get it green before cutoff. :thumbsup:
carla: posting patch now: PR #4123 (cherry-pick of #4021) — marked WIP until rebased.
alice: perfect. i'll draft the branch tomorrow morning and post exact cut timestamp. thanks all. :rocket:
